summary: Dipping an acid potion into water skips C pot_acid_damage(): trap.c:water_damage() describes the potion explosion, calls setnotworn() and delobj(), and updates inventory. JavaScript water_damage() reaches an injected callback or records pot_acid_damage as unported, so it leaves the potion in place and misses delobj()’s obj_resists() RNG call. The source owner is trap.c:pot_acid_damage, not the queue’s zap.c:obj_resists annotation.

source.branch: When water_damage() is called on a carried acid potion by dipping it in uncursed water, or after water washes grease from an acid potion; the ungreased potion-class branch also reaches it after luck protection.
callers: trap.c:water_damage() calls pot_acid_damage() in its grease-wash acid branch (4744-4748) and potion-class acid branch (4824-4827).
potion.c:H2Opotion_dip() calls water_damage(targobj, 0, TRUE) for a carried target (1538-1545); dodip() invokes H2Opotion_dip() after #dip object/potion selection (2460-2464).
js/potion.js:H2Opotion_dip() calls water_damage(target, 0, true, env); js/trap_water_damage.js:water_damage() calls its acidDamage() placeholder in both corresponding branches.
dependencies: invent.c:delobj() is already ported in js/invent.js; it calls the existing obj_resists() port before extraction, matching the C rn2(100) observed at zap.c:1469.
The admitted recording selects an uncursed potion of acid and an uncursed potion of water, runs #dip, then selects the acid target; the C explosion and deletion occur at segment 0, step 59.

evidence: The saved v38 queue evaluation at 5e20fb15440a1b3cf46cdb4e61b822b8b6d50ed0 matches 59/60 screens and cursors, then diverges at segment 0, step 59: C displays “A…” and JS displays “C…”, while C consumes rn2(100)=41 in obj_resists(zap.c:1469). The diagnostic lists unported trap.c pot_acid_damage.

The independent C recipe challenges/cases/v38/v38-water-dip-destroys-acid-potion.recipe.session.json gives a Wizard uncursed acid and water potions, issues #dip, and selects the acid potion; its recording and manifest hashes are retained in this report.

trap.c:4657-4707 defines pot_acid_damage(): blind floor objects lose dknown, the helper selects singular/plural and first/subsequent explosion wording from ga.acid_ctx, updates dkn_boom/unk_boom, then calls setnotworn(), delobj(), and update_inventory() for inventory objects.

potion.c:1538-1545 reaches water_damage() from H2Opotion_dip(); potion.c:2460-2464 calls that helper from dodip(). js/trap_water_damage.js:232-238 currently only runs env.potAcidDamage or note_unported(), which explains both the missing explosion/deletion and the absent RNG draw.
